description: manni docs cite/set-up/public-docs-private-code, run with the docs checkout at docs/ and the code checked out beside it at code/, as the page's two-job workflow lays them out. The key is one the reader generated (openssl rand -hex 32).

steps.description: Step 2: mint a citation from the docs checkout, with the key in the environment. The dry run shows the manifest entry with an encrypted source and a keyed pin.

runShell.command: MANNI_ENCRYPTION_KEY=55d04190162e4bcfe93063dd2f172733a8ed10d651449251c64525d0764c51e7 npx @hawkeyexl/manni cite add src/content/docs/limits.md:14 lib/limits.ts:3 --id configurable --encrypt --root ../code --dry-run
runShell.stdio: /--- docs-citations\.yaml[\s\S]*\+    - id: configurable[\s\S]*\+        lines: 11[\s\S]*\+        file: ~[A-Za-z0-9_-]{82,}[\s\S]*\+        integrity: hmac-sha256-[0-9a-f]{64}/

steps.description: The dry run wrote nothing: the manifest still holds one citation.
--encrypt with no key is a refusal: off a terminal, add writes nothing and exits 2.

runShell.command: npx @hawkeyexl/manni cite add src/content/docs/limits.md:14 lib/limits.ts:3 --id configurable --encrypt --root ../code
runShell.stdio: manni: lib/limits.ts:3 must be encrypted, and no encryption key is available. Run `manni key set`, or set MANNI_ENCRYPTION_KEY.

steps.description: Step 3: the public job, with no key and no code, runs the page-side rules only. The claim end is checked; the source end is skipped.

runShell.stdio: /fetch-timeout\s+:9 current\s+lib\/limits\.ts:4 skipped\s+docs-citations\.yaml:4[\s\S]*1 file checked, 1 passed, 0 failed, 0 findings/

steps.description: Step 4: the private job, with the key and --root pointing at the code checkout.

runShell.stdio: /fetch-timeout\s+:9 current\s+lib\/limits\.ts:4 current\s+docs-citations\.yaml:4[\s\S]*1 file checked, 1 passed, 0 failed, 0 findings/

steps.description: Locally, --reveal prints the decrypted path beside an encrypted source, in the pretty reporter.
